gold_note: Crocodyliform time tree, 85 tips. Read from the image's own black lines by a tracer (root at the bottom; only the connected tree ink, with short tip lines kept where a coloured range bar sits on them), then checked against the figure node by node and the tips named in printed order. Twenty-one clade names are kept as internal labels, each on the node above the bar that crosses its stem (SUCHIA at the root; 'advanced notosuchians' as printed, lower case); MESOEUCROCODYLIA excludes Hsisosuchus and THALATTOSUCHIA excludes Hyposaurus, as their bars show. Polytomies: Crocodylomorpha (Terrestrisuchus, Dibothrosuchus, Crocodyliformes); Notosuchia (Libycosuchus, Uruguaysuchidae and the rest, on one bar); four Baurusuchus/Stratiotosuchus tips; Sphagesauridae (four children); Caryonosuchus-Sphagesaurus-Armadillosuchus; Itasuchidae (four tips); and five sebecids (Pehuenchesuchus to Bergisuchus). 85 tips, 7 polytomies (3, 3, 4, 4, 3, 4, 5 children); 21 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 7 case (census 2, seed 20261241). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
